name: Eaglethorpe board and barns

layers.essential_history: The Proby family has owned farmland around Warmington since Sir Peter Proby first acquired land at Elton in 1595, and has held Elton Hall since 1660. [[r:The board also mentions a possible late Saxon hamlet and a survey of 1621. The dovecote is said to have about 800 nests.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[r:An Early Bronze Age burial was found near the mill in 1995. Sources differ on its exact date. It is a findspot, not a place to visit.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: the estate is old and grand, and its stores are full. That makes a missing sack all the harder to notice.]]
